text.tspan: What happens when you open https://shop.example.com/cart
CSS, JS, images reuse the connection (HTTP/2) · idle ones close later: FIN, then TIME_WAIT
⑦ TLS 1.3 ClientHello: SNI shop.example.com, ALPN h2
ServerHello, certificate (ACM), Finished · browser checks chain, SAN, dates
